items.headline: The mighty Dodgers are reeling — a walk-off in Arizona makes it seven straight losses
items.body: The two-time champs are in a genuine skid: rookie Ryan Waldschmidt crushed a two-run, walk-off homer off closer Edwin Díaz to give the Diamondbacks a 4-3 win Friday night, dropping the Dodgers to their seventh straight loss — their longest slide since 2017. A team that loaded up at the deadline has been outscored 44-23 during the streak, though they still lead the NL West by 7.5.
items.say: The Dodgers have somehow lost seven in a row — a rookie just walked them off in Arizona. After they went and traded for everybody, that's kind of wild. You following the pennant races at all?

items.headline: The MVP is back — Napheesa Collier returns, and tonight she meets A'ja Wilson
items.body: MVP frontrunner Napheesa Collier finally returned from double ankle surgery and picked up right where she left off — 24 points and 10 rebounds in just 22 minutes in her season debut. Now the league-leading Lynx and A'ja Wilson's Aces meet Saturday in the marquee matchup of the two best players in the world, both smack in the middle of the MVP race.
items.say: Napheesa Collier's back from injury and dropped 24 and 10 in her first game — and tonight she goes head-to-head with A'ja Wilson, the two best players in the league. The WNBA's been so good this year. You been watching?

items.headline: Messi vs. a Liga MX heavyweight — Inter Miami host Monterrey tonight
items.body: The MLS-vs-Liga MX tournament serves up a Saturday-night blockbuster: fresh off a record-setting brace, Lionel Messi and Inter Miami host Mexican giant Monterrey in Fort Lauderdale (8pm ET). Miami are without suspended Luis Suárez and will have their hands full with Rayados' red-hot Lucas Ocampos, Liga MX's current top scorer. A proper heavyweight tie.
items.say: Messi and Miami play one of the big Mexican teams tonight — Monterrey — in that Leagues Cup. Every one of those US-vs-Mexico games has been a battle. You throwing any of it on this weekend?

items.headline: Mourinho's Real Madrid are going all-in — a 'win-now' rebuild in Madrid
items.body: The summer window's other blockbuster: José Mourinho is back at Real Madrid, running an aggressive 'win-now' overhaul. They've already reeled in Bernardo Silva, Ibrahima Konaté (a free from Liverpool), Marc Cucurella from Chelsea and Denzel Dumfries — and they're even circling Manchester City's Rodri. A very different, very Mourinho-flavored Madrid is taking shape.
items.say: Did you hear Mourinho's back at Real Madrid? And they're spending like crazy — Bernardo Silva, Konaté, Cucurella. The transfer window this summer has been nuts. You follow the European stuff at all?

items.headline: The draw just blew wide open — Griekspoor stuns top seed Zverev in Montreal
items.body: The National Bank Open, the last big US Open tune-up, got a jolt: Tallon Griekspoor knocked off top seed Alexander Zverev — fresh off his first Grand Slam title — 6-7, 6-2, 6-4 in Montreal. With Sinner, Alcaraz and Djokovic all skipping this one, the door is now wide open for someone to grab a Masters 1000 title before New York.
items.say: The big Canadian tennis event had a huge upset — some guy ranked way down knocked out the top seed, Zverev, who just won his first major. With the top three guys all sitting out, it's anyone's title. You watch any tennis?

items.headline: Spider-Man just crossed a billion dollars — in six days
items.body: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' isn't slowing down. After the biggest opening weekend in history, it blew past $1 billion worldwide in just six days — the second-fastest ever, behind only 'Avengers: Endgame' — and is now the highest-grossing movie of 2026 at roughly $1.15 billion. It's still parked at No. 1 this weekend, with $2 billion in its sights.
items.say: That Spider-Man movie hit a billion dollars in six days — it's already the biggest film of the year. Absolutely bonkers numbers. You get out to see it yet?

items.headline: Clear your Sunday — 'House of the Dragon' airs its Season 3 finale
items.body: Westeros fans, this is the big one: 'House of the Dragon' drops its Season 3 finale on Sunday (Aug 9) on HBO Max — the eighth and final episode of the season, teed up for the long-building Team Black vs. Team Green showdown after weeks of chess-piece maneuvering. Expect betrayals, dragons and plenty of Monday-morning chatter.
items.say: House of the Dragon wraps up its season Sunday night — it's been building to this huge showdown all year. Great one if you need weekend TV. You keeping up with it?

items.headline: One for the weekend playlist — FLO's slick second album 'Therapy at the Club'
items.body: British R&B trio FLO returned Friday with their sophomore album 'Therapy at the Club' — 16 tracks of immaculate harmonies and glossy, 2000s-pop-inflected R&B that critics are calling a confident step up. If you're after some smooth, feel-good weekend music, this is the one everyone's spinning right now.
items.say: There's a British girl group called FLO who dropped a new album Friday — really slick throwback R&B, perfect weekend playlist stuff. You come across them yet?
